text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, when I visited a cafe...
I spotted Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren ordered the new flavor!
I wonder if I can do a good food review?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's chattering away to herself
in front of the smartphone placed on the table...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Part A is good to go.
The next shoot is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother?
Wow, what a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis?
Wow, what a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just now?
I was updating Umatube!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"UmaTube." A video sharing service wildly popular
with people of all ages. But to think
she'd even expanded into UmaTube...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Jeez, what are you talking about!
Of course I'm updating it at the exact same time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You see, I did set up an UmaTube channel a while ago~,
but I wasn't really focusing on it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“From now on, though,
I'm thinking of smashing through my records again and again!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because to become the most beloved Umamusume,
I have to get lots of people to know Curren, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then appealing to the massive audience
on UmaTube might be pretty important too~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! Onii-chan,
please make sure to subscribe to "Curren channel♪"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! Onee-chan,
please make sure to subscribe to "Curren channel♪"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren will teach you how to do it!
First, make an account—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for subscribing♪
With this, UmaTube is set up perfectly. Now all that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to follow me on
Umatok and Umatter, too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I'm planning to update that one right after this♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I know! At this café, the Special Café Latte is totally recommended!
Curren will teach you how to order it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, despite coming out just to buy
drinks, I somehow ended up tagging along
for Curren Chan's social media shoot...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Face Challenge: Start♪
Ready, go!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Kyahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Big Brother, could you show me that video from just now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Big Sister, could you show me that video from just now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Okay♪
Let's go with this for UmaTok!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, your arms are trembling, Onii-chan...
You were holding the smartphone for so long, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, your arms are trembling, Onee-chan...
You were holding the smartphone for so long, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, okay? Doing 107 retakes and all.
Thanks to that, we got a quality I'm truly satisfied with!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We've recorded the dance,
so next is updating Umatter!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I just use Umatter
to drive traffic over to UmaTube and Umastagram, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The audience is pretty different, so there are some photos I only post on Umatter♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Oh, the lighting here is great!
Big Brother, take a picture for me~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Oh, the lighting here is great!
Big Sister, take a picture for me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click-click-click-click)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, thanks.
Now, add a quick caption
to this photo... and post!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I check her post right away.
Accompanying a photo of her smiling languidly against the sunset is the caption, 'Let's go on another date.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was just a regular photo of Curren Chan, but
the speed at which it spread was staggering...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing, is this the fastest ever?
Photos taken by other people really are the best♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
My impression is that on Umatter,
people really like a sense of ongoing narrative!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Rather than an aggressive push,
a casual single-sentence post
seems easier for everyone to spread."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't fully understand, but she seemed to use
each tool differently in her own way.
However...
choice_data_list: You didn't have to push the record this far...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spending the day with her made me realize that updating social media is far tougher than I imagined.
Ideally, I'd prefer her to focus solely on racing, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Onii-chan, Curren is totally fine, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Onee-chan, Curren is totally fine, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Updating social media is Curren's duty,
and chatting with everyone helps me unwind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So don't worry, Onii-chan,
just look forward to the Aoi Stakes, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So don't worry, Onee-chan,
just look forward to the Aoi Stakes, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her bright smile, there's an overwhelming pressure...
It feels like she won't let me say another word.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's about time to update Umastagram.
Stick with me until the end, okay, Big Brother?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's about time to update Umastagram.
Stick with me until the end, okay, Big Sister?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the matter was left unsettled...
and the day turned into a photoshoot
filled with countless pictures of Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
'#CuteCurrenChan
#AoiStakes #JapaneseDerby
#CheckOutMyRaceFirst♪'
